en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammānulomapaccanīya (3), Dukadukapaṭṭhānapāḷi (6) 18.4.
Hetuduka, Cūḷantaraduka
A state that is neither-root nor non-condition is a condition, by way of object-condition,
for a state that is neither-root nor non-condition … pe … A state that is neither-root nor non-condition is a condition, by way of object-condition,
for a state that is neither-root nor non-condition and for a state that is neither-root nor non-condition and neither-root nor non-condition.
And [it is] a condition for the Dhamma by way of the object-condition. (Abbreviated.
With respect to the object, there are three [types of conditions]: predominance, decisive support, and so forth. (The unconditioned is like that which has no condition.
A non-root, visible phenomenon is a condition for a non-root, invisible phenomenon by way of the object-condition.
Condition. A state that is not-root and with visibility is a condition, by way of object-condition, for a state that is neither-root nor with visibility.

A state that is not-root and with visibility is a condition, by way of object-condition, for a state that is neither-root nor with visibility and for a state that is neither-not-root nor with visibility.
(Abbreviated. Three [conditions] in the case of the object; [three] in the case of the predominance and decisive-support conditions.
With regard to pre-arisen states, there are three [conditions]: presence and non-disappearance.

Dependent on a rootless, non-visible phenomenon, arises a non-root, non-visible phenomenon by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition, there are three; under predominance condition, there are three …pe… under non-disappearance condition, there are three.

Dependent on a non-root, impinging phenomenon, arises a non-root, non-impinging phenomenon by way of root condition. Under root condition, there is one; under predominance condition, there is one …pe… under non-disappearance condition, there is one.

Dependent on a non-reactive state that is not a root-cause, there arises a state that is neither a root-cause nor non-reactive, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root-condition: three; under predominance-condition: three … pe … under mutuality-condition: one … pe … under non-disappearance-condition: three.

Dependent on a material state that is not a root-cause, there arises a state that is neither a root-cause nor material, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root-condition: three; under object-condition: three … pe … under non-disappearance-condition: three.

Dependent on a cause that is a non-material phenomenon (*arūpa-dhamma*), there arises a non-cause, non-non-material phenomenon by way of root condition (*hetu-paccaya*). (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; under predominance condition (*adhipati*) there are three ... pe ...

under non-disappearance condition (*avigata*) there are three. Dependent on a non-cause, mundane phenomenon (*lokiya-dhamma*), there arises a non-non-cause, non-mundane phenomenon by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.
Dependent on a cause that is a supramundane phenomenon (*lokuttara-dhamma*), there arises a non-cause, non-supramundane phenomenon by way of root condition.
Dependent on a non-root supramundane state, a non-root non-supramundane state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on both a root supramundane state and a non-root supramundane state, a non-root non-supramundane state arises by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. There are three for root; three for predominance ... pe ... three for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a root-dhamma cognizable by some [consciousness], a non-root dhamma not cognizable by any [consciousness] arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Nine in the case of root; ... pe ... nine in the case of non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-root dhamma not cognizable by any [consciousness], a non-root dhamma not cognizable by any [consciousness] arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Nine in the case of root; ... pe ... nine in the case of non-disappearance.
